text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Say, Tact— 
Since it's your day off, 
would you like to go out for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the invitation, Win Marilyn. 
I truly appreciate the thought, but—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I booked a lesson room 
two hours from now, so—

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that's more than enough time. 
I'll be your escort, so what do you say?

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
—Someone I co-starred with before told me 
about this place. 
Do you like it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The atmosphere here is just lovely♪ 
I had no idea a place like this was so 
close to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"I'm glad you enjoyed it. 
Ever since I saw photos of the place, I've 
wanted 
to come here with you, Daring Tact."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Oh? Isn't this what 
Win Marilyn was telling me about 
before...?"

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, recovery wear. If you're 
interested, would you like me to recommend 
a good brand?"

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"—Now then, we've gotten the treats for 
everyone, 
so shall we head back?"

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"Was it a bit too hectic? 
I'm sorry if it felt too rushed."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Not at all! It was so fulfilling. 
I feel like I've spent an entire day 
playing!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"The idea of heading out during little 
moments 
of free time like this never really 
occurred to me..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"It really brought it home to me. 
In the city, just stepping outside opens 
the door 
to doing so many different things."

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"Hehe, that's true. So long as you make 
good use of your time, 
you can pack in as much fulfillment as you 
like."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: I see... Making good use of time...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, maybe I can use the interval 
breaks to check my running form?"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact began approaching her training 
more 
efficiently than ever before, polishing 
her running 
to an even finer edge.

title: Making the Most of Fleeting Moments
